name: Helpjuice
description: Helpjuice is a cloud-based knowledge base platform that helps organizations create, organize, and search internal and customer-facing documentation, aiming to reduce support tickets and speed up onboarding.
best_for: Positioned for support teams, operations, customer success, and high-growth SaaS companies looking to replace scattered documentation in tools like Notion, Confluence, or internal wikis.
features: AI-powered search that interprets intent and forgives typos
AI content creation that drafts articles from Slack messages, support tickets, and emails
Swifty AI chatbot integrated into the knowledge base
Analytics dashboard tracking article usage, engagement, and topic consumption
Multi-language support with translation across 50+ languages
Customizable, branded themes with no developer required
